items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Well the first time I went in Basie’s band was right out of Lunceford’s band.

ctx.x: You spent two or three periods with Basie, right? One of which was fairly long.

Well the first time I went in Basie’s band was right out of Lunceford’s band. I replaced Buck Clayton. Buck Clayton had to have his tonsils out. I had left Lunceford and I was in my home town just in between whatever might happen. And so they needed a trumpet player to replace Buck so I went in the band for a month and replaced Buck and so when Buck came back I went on back home. And then I went to California to join Gerald Wilson, no, Lee Young and Lester Young. I went to California to join that band. And I…

items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I stayed with Count Basie till I went on the Tonight Show. I never played with anybody else other than Basie

ctx.x: When I recorded then I stayed with Count Basie…till…till…I stayed with Count Basie till I went on the Tonight Show. I never played with anybody else other than Basie, and I stayed with Basie and then I went on the Tonight Show. What year did I go on the Tonight Show?
